claims.text: Clinically significant diabetic macular edema: anti-VEGF (ranibizumab, bevacizumab, aflibercept, high-dose aflibercept) and/or focal laser; faricimab (VEGF-A + angiopoietin-2 inhibitor) appears similar to aflibercept
claims.quote: Clinically significant diabetic macular edema is treated with intraocular injection of anti-VEGF medications (eg, ranibizumab, bevacizumab, aflibercept, high-dose aflibercept), and/or with focal laser photocoagulation (4). Intravitreal faricimab, which is a dual inhibitor of VEGF-A and angiopoietin-2, is also available for the treatment of diabetic macular edema and appears similar to aflibercept
